children: RNS Number : 1920Z  Insig AI Plc  16 October 2026
Change of Name to Candessa AI plc

Following shareholder approval of the proposed change of the Company's registered name at the Company's Annual General Meeting held on 14 October 2026, the registered name of the Company is now Candessa AI plc.

With effect from 8:00 on 19 October 2026, trading on AIM will commence under the Company's new registered name and the new Tradable Instrument Display Mnemonic (TIDM) will be CAS (previously INSG). The Company's ISIN GB00BYV31355 and LEI 21380098CKBAG1NWCD98 remain unchanged.
Shareholders are unaffected by the changes and existing share certificates will remain valid and should be retained.
The Company's website address has also been updated to candessa.com.
